shared_elements: low-relief carving on a single broad face
composition divided into stacked horizontal registers
a row of repeated small motifs along the upper edge
horizontal band of linear/geometric pattern separating registers
animal or creature shown in profile
bird-like head with beak in profile
justification: Both are tall upright carved monoliths whose broad face is divided into stacked horizontal registers, each with a row of repeated small motifs across the top and a ruled band of linear ornament beneath, below which profile creatures are set — a genuinely comparable compositional scheme. The manner of carving is quite different, however: A is dense, deeply cut and crowded with interlocking curvilinear detail and block-like glyphic panels leaving almost no empty ground, while B is sparse, shallow and schematic, with isolated flat silhouettes floating on wide blank surface.
